description: Read a whole message: headers, body and attachments. Name it by exactly one of ref or message_id. Image attachments arrive as pictures you see with the result; small text attachments carry text_preview, and each attachment's path can be attached to a reply.

ref.description: message.ref from an email.event or a search result.

message_id.description: Message-ID such as <id@example.com>, when no ref is at hand.

mailbox.description: Folder to look in for message_id; INBOX, All Mail, Sent and Archive by default.
